scope: All ordinary body-flow citations, their frozen nearby claims, primary publication records and exact supporting passages, canonical BibTeX metadata, closest-prior-result comparison, user-library relevance, bibliography coverage, and final AUX/log consistency were checked. Mathematical correctness remains governed by the accepted frozen math audit.
citation_audit_method: Two-stage citation-check protocol: first freeze the complete claim/key ledger, then independently run the applicable author/year/title, exact-title, venue, DOI, and arXiv searches and inspect the primary theorem, problem, definition, abstract, or full-text passage; finish with the hook-compatible user-library validator and canonical BibTeX/AUX/log checks.
